qlever.listener: QLever default bind address, temporary port; requests use loopback
qlever.scope: Sequential single-client warm queries. Shardborough uses a pinned full-graph JSONL snapshot; competitor uses native HTTP with a new loopback connection per request. Both include full serialization and body transfer; JSON parsing, validation and capture-file writes are outside timing. One warmup, alternating paired order, no OS cache eviction. Transport and admission models differ; no industry parity claim.

workloads.name: predicate-count
workloads.timing_excluded_reason: COUNT returns xsd:int rather than xsd:integer; excluded from paired timings

workloads.name: limit-slice
workloads.query: SELECT ?subject ?name WHERE { ?subject <urn:scale:name> ?name } ORDER BY ?subject OFFSET 3 LIMIT 7

virtuoso.answer_comparison: Exact ordered bindings and RDF term fields. Remove only QLever meta or Virtuoso head.link/results.distinct/results.ordered extensions. Known term/shape differences are reported and excluded from latency comparisons, never coerced.
virtuoso.cache_policy: Shardborough has no answer cache. QLever uses -c '0 B' -k 0. Virtuoso uses the retained minimal native configuration; no claim that all of its internal caches are disabled.
virtuoso.configuration:
[Database]
DatabaseFile = db.db
ErrorLogFile = db.log
LockFile = db.lck
TransactionFile = db.trx
FileExtend = 200
TempStorage = TempDatabase
[TempDatabase]
DatabaseFile = temp.db
TransactionFile = temp.trx
[Parameters]
ServerPort = 127.0.0.1:63205
DisableUnixSocket = 1
NumberOfBuffers = 10000
MaxDirtyBuffers = 6000
DirsAllowed = .
MaxQueryMem = 256M
ThreadsPerQuery = 1
AsyncQueueMaxThreads = 1
CheckpointInterval = 0
[HTTPServer]
ServerPort = 127.0.0.1:63204
ServerRoot = .
MaxClientConnections = 4
[SPARQL]
ResultSetMaxRows = 100010
MaxQueryExecutionTime = 60
